description: The shuffling corpse of a medium dinosaur with sharp teeth and two prominent bony crests on its head with ragged strips of ripped flesh hanging down like a frill.
//: All dinos over 23 kg should have a zombie version to zombify into

description: This zombie is enormous, scaly, studded with bony spikes, and it moves with horrible speed.  Its colorful horns are worn and wet with filth and its bright scales and bone spikes have taken a beating.
Enormous putrid dinosaur corpse with a ferocious crocodile-like head, oozing black eyes, and a tattered sail on its back.
The shambling corpse of a large predatory bipedal dinosaur, with tiger-like stripes on its broad, scaled back.
The shambling corpse of a huge predatory bipedal dinosaur, with a tall ridge running down the length of its back covered with heavy muscles.  Its teeth are curved and serrated like sawblades.
The shambling corpse of a huge predatory bipedal dinosaur with long claws and strong arms for grappling.
Massive piles of ragged, stinking flesh lifting enormous teeth.
Massive jaws drooling black liquid lifted over grasping claws by a huge shuffling dinosaur corpse.
The shuffling corpse of a medium-sized bipedal dinosaur covered with tattered feathers and black putrid liquid.
The shuffling corpse of a large-sized bipedal dinosaur covered with tattered feathers and black putrid liquid.  Sharp curved claws protrude from its hands.
The shuffling corpse of a medium-sized bipedal dinosaur covered with tattered feathers and black putrid liquid.  Both feet brandish a large sickle-like claw.
The swaying, hopping corpse of a large bipedal dinosaur with feathered arms, a long tail, and long sharp scythe-like claws.
Massive, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur corpse with a long, whip-like tail.  The head is upright and the neck looks like it would still make a good strong club.
Massive, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur corpse with a bulky torso and a long, whip-like tail.
Huge, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur with a long, whip-like tail and a tiny head with vacant white eyes.  Sways and staggers.
Massive, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur corpse with a long, whip-like tail.  The head is upright and the neck looks like it would still make a good strong club.
Gigantic, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur corpse with longer forelegs and a whip-like tail.
Gigantic, long-necked, four-legged dinosaur corpse with a long neck and spiked tail protected by natural bone armor.
A large shambling quadruped dinosaur corpse dragging with the weight of the plates on its back, waving a much livelier looking spiked tail.
This armored dinosaur corpse looks like a giant prehistoric armadillo.  Its tail ends in a spiked club of bone.
The shuffling corpse of what looks like a giant armadillo with peeling armored plates and black, glistening eyes.  Its tail ends in a massive spiked club of bone.
This heavily armored dinosaur corpse looks like a giant prehistoric armadillo.
This heavily armored dinosaur corpse looks like a giant prehistoric armadillo with long bony spikes.
The shuffling corpse of a large feathered bipedal dinosaur with strong legs, broad shoulders and a pointed beak.  Its tattered feathers are stained with black, sticky liquid.
A huge mottled dinosaur with hooves and heavy tail, dead and walking, eyes vacant and swollen.  Has a flat beak, thick nose, and small spiky head crest.
A huge mottled dinosaur with a blunt head crest, dead and walking, eyes vacant and swollen.
A huge scaly dinosaur with a short beak and a tall head crest, dead and walking, eyes vacant and swollen.
A huge scaly dinosaur with a broad toothless beak, dead and walking, eyes vacant and swollen.
The shuffling corpse of a medium-sized bipedal dinosaur covered with tattered feathers and black putrid liquid.  It looks like a reptilian ostrich with a round hard-looking domed head.
A massive shambling rhino-like dinosaur corpse with a tall bony crest from which four long horns and a short nose horn emerge.  Its black eyes ooze like tears.
A massive shambling rhino-like dinosaur corpse with a tall bony crest from which four long horns and a short nose horn emerge.  Its black eyes ooze like tears.
A massive shambling rhino-like dinosaur corpse with a tall bony crest from which two wicked looking horns emerge.  Its black eyes ooze like tears.
A massive shambling rhino-like dinosaur corpse with a bony crest from which three wicked looking horns emerge.  Its black eyes ooze like tears.
The raggedly flying corpse of a large feathered reptile with a long pointed toothless beak and a long pointy head crest.
The raggedly flying corpse of a large feathered reptile with a long pointed toothless beak and a long rigid neck.
The ragged bloated corpse of a huge aquatic dinosaur the size of a house, with a crocodile-like head and swimming fins.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse, it could be from a number of different species.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse, it could be from a number of different species.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse, it could be from a number of different species.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse, it could be from a number of different species.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse, it could be from a number of different species.
A small four-legged plant-eating dinosaur juvenile corpse with natural bone armor plates.
An undead Qianzhousaurus, looking at you with a furious rage in its eyes and seeming intent on eating you.
An undead Kosmoceratops, it seems to have forgotten it's herbivore diet, and seems hungry for your flesh.
A zombie amargasaurus, it has begun using its spikes for hunting.
